schemaDescription: Join Myntmore as a B2B Lead Generation Intern in BKC, Mumbai. Learn outbound sales and pipeline building across LinkedIn, cold email, and AI tools. Freshers welcome, full-time internship.
aboutIntro:
We're looking for a sharp, curious, and fast-learning B2B Lead Generation Intern who wants to learn how modern outbound sales actually works. You don't need years of experience. We're looking for someone who pays attention to detail, is comfortable with data and spreadsheets, and genuinely wants to understand what makes a prospect reply to an email or accept a LinkedIn connection.

Already have outbound experience? See the B2B Lead Generation Strategist role.
aboutNoteText: Already have outbound experience? See the B2B Lead Generation Strategist role.
aboutCalloutText: Most sales internships put you on cold calling or data entry for a single product. At Myntmore, you'll support outbound campaigns across multiple real B2B clients: software founders, IT services firms, consultants, and recruiters. You'll see how different industries buy, and learn the tools and systems agencies use to book 12K+ meetings.
primaryGoal: Learn the fundamentals of B2B lead generation by working directly on live client accounts. By month 3, you should be able to build a clean prospect list, write a first-draft outbound sequence, and understand why a campaign booked or missed its target.

responsibilities.title: Prospect Research
responsibilities.desc: Build target lists of the right companies and decision-makers using LinkedIn and data tools, and check that every contact is accurate before it goes into a campaign.

responsibilities.title: ICP + Messaging Support
responsibilities.desc: Help define who a client should target and why. Draft personalised outbound messages and learn what makes a message get a reply.

responsibilities.title: Campaign Operations
responsibilities.desc: Support live outreach on LinkedIn and cold email. Learn to manage sequencing, track bounce rates, and keep inboxes healthy with tools like Apollo, Clay, Instantly, and Waalaxy.

responsibilities.title: Performance Tracking
responsibilities.desc: Log replies, booked meetings, and campaign metrics daily so the team knows what's working and where to improve.

responsibilities.title: AI & Workflow Learning
responsibilities.desc: Work with modern AI agents and automation tools, and learn how to use them to research accounts faster and personalize outreach at scale.

whoYouAreIntro: Freshers and final-year students are welcome. No outbound experience required. We care more about how carefully you work and how fast you learn than what's on your resume.

whoYouAre.label: Detail-Oriented
whoYouAre.desc: You notice spelling errors, bad data, and wrong job titles before anyone points them out

whoYouAre.label: Curious
whoYouAre.desc: You want to understand why things work, not just follow steps blindly

whoYouAre.label: Comfortable with Tech
whoYouAre.desc: Good with Google Sheets, quick to pick up new software, and open to using AI tools

whoYouAre.label: Strong Written English
whoYouAre.desc: You can write clear, concise messages without corporate jargon or fluff

whoYouAre.label: Reliable
whoYouAre.desc: When you own a task, the team knows it gets done accurately and on time

whoYouAre.label: Hungry to Learn
whoYouAre.desc: You want hands-on experience in B2B growth, not a desk job where nobody teaches you

skills: Curious + Fast Learner: questions over assumptions
Careful With Data: clean lists mean good campaigns
Good Writer: short, clear, human sentences
AI-Curious: open to working with AI agents and tools
Reliable: ownership of daily and weekly tasks
whatYoullLearn: How real B2B outbound lead generation works from the ground up
How to research companies, map decision-makers, and build ICPs
How cold email deliverability, DNS records, and inbox warming actually work
How to write cold messages that start conversations instead of getting deleted
Hands-on experience with modern tools: Clay, Apollo, Instantly, Waalaxy, and AI tools
whyJoin: Work from our BKC office in Mumbai with an ambitious, close-knit team. Learn the growth systems very few college graduates get exposed to, with high potential to transition into a full-time Lead Generation Strategist role based on performance.
